about: Suggested presets for the Atelier pages, collected section by section from the values the styled sections use (block attributes). Not applied: presets can clash with the active theme. Once every section is done, the values used in more than one place become presets (font sizes with fluid: false, spacing sizes) registered by the plugin, and the blocks switch to var:preset references. Colors are already presets (includes/class-design-tokens.php).

usedIn: header: navigation link padding (Bronze hover style)

spacing.note: Not a preset: core drops a clamp() typed in a block gap, so the value is in the blocks' CSS attribute (Advanced). A spacing preset would let it live in the gap control.

usedIn: header: primary button background and border
header: hover of links and button (block styles)
